messages:
leah: Quick async check — owners, what are the current blocking items for the Optimize toolkit delivery? Focus: quantization recommendations, batching defaults, and KV/prefix cache integration. Need green flag or clear blockers by EOD Fri.
rav: On quant recs — we've validated 4-bit dynamic (q4_dyn) for the smaller families. Good perf/cost tradeoff, but long-context (>8k) fails with dequant edgecases. Filed PR: https://git.redwood.dev/r/opt/quant/187 — needs review.
anya: Batching update: bumped default batch_size from 8 → 12 in the experiments branch. Throughput up ~18% but p95 latency on small requests increased ~12ms. Suggest canary in dedicated pool first.
sam: Regression alert: saw embedding drift when KV cache + q4_dyn are enabled together in staging. Added test case tst_embed_kv_342 and linked repro steps in the issue: https://git.redwood.dev/r/opt/regressions/342. Root cause looks like partial-misses in cache lookup when token ids are normalized differently after quant decode.
rav: Re: sam — I reproduced locally. Short-term mitigation: force cache key to use raw token bytes (see snippet). Long-term: fix decode/normalize path.

```yaml
# suggested cache-key change
cache_key: "raw_tokens_v1"
normalize: false
```

leah: Good catch. Who's owning the cache key mitigation? We should avoid a hotfix that regresses other clients.
anya: I can own a canary for the batching change (eng-platform). Will run against dedicated pool on Tue morning.
sam: I'll own the cache-key mitigation PR, target Wed. I'll add a regression test matrix that toggles quant/batch/cache combos.
ci-bot: CI status: pipeline optimize-toolkit/staging #428 — failing (1 test) — tst_embed_kv_342. Full logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/build/428/logs
rav: I'll review the quant PR today and add notes for long-context failures. If we can't patch q4_dyn decode fast, fallback route: route long-context requests to q8 or a non-quantized variant.
leah: Action items summarised: 1) sam - PR for cache-key mitigation (Wed) 2) anya - batching canary on dedicated (Tue AM) 3) rav - review quant PR + fallback plan (EOD today) 4) QA - add regression matrix (blocking for green). We'll reconvene here after canary results. :thumbsup:
anya: noted. ping me if you need canary capacity — I can allocate burst. :rocket:
sam: added checklist to issue and tagged QA.
leah: Thanks all. If anyone hits a new blocker, drop it here with short repro and priority.
ci-bot: Reminder — deploy freeze Thurs 00:00 -> Mon 00:00 for infra upgrades. Planning around that?
leah: Yes, will avoid any wide rollouts during freeze window. Canary scheduled before freeze.
rav: FYI I'll include perf counters in the PR so we can compare CPU/GPU utilization with quant vs fallback.
sam: will include perf numbers in PR description.
leah: Closing the async thread for now — will post an updated status after canary. :white_check_mark:
